messages:
Maya R: Heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for the feature flag `shared-prefix-cache` in eu-west tonight. Target window: 03:00 UTC. Rollout plan: start at 10% traffic, validate smoke checks, then 50% -> 100% if stable. Who can own the deploy and smoke? Also confirming safe defaults will remain enabled (we don't want a full-cache-on by accident).
Oliver T: I reviewed the PR, CI green. I can trigger the rollout at 02:55 UTC and watch the push. Will leave canary at 10% for ~10m first. :thumbsup:
Jun P: Can we run the smoke against staging first (same env vars)? Also which dashboards + alerts should we watch — can someone post the exact queries?
Sasha L: I can run smoke and own rollback. Quick checklist I will follow:
1) kick 10% via feature-service
2) run smoke script
3) watch per-tenant latency + errors for 10m
4) if error rate >5% or p95 latency +30% -> rollback
Smoke command I use:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --env eu-west --flag shared-prefix-cache --target 10
```
I’ll stream results here.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued — flag rollout for `shared-prefix-cache` scheduled at 02:55 UTC (initiated by Oliver T).
Maya R: Important: ensure config.service has `safe_default=true` for this flag. If safe_default is missing, abort and notify me.
Oliver T: Confirmed: safe_default=true is present. Rollback command (if needed):
```
redwoodctl flag set --name shared-prefix-cache --off --immediate --reason "rollback: perf regressed"
```
Jun P: Grafana dashboard to watch:
https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/flags-ops?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west
Key panels: `kv_cache.hit_rate`, `request_latency_p50`, `request_latency_p95`, `error_rate`.
I'll be on the dashboard during the window and ping Pager if thresholds cross.
Sasha L: Will post smoke output here within ~15m of rollout. If anything looks off I'll execute rollback and note the reason.
Maya R: Thanks all — tagging @oncall (Jun P) and @infra (Oliver T) for visibility. If no red flags after canary, proceed to 50% at +30m. :white_check_mark:
